WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'ps-%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'preschool%' THEN -2
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'tk-%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'transitional kindergarten%' THEN -1
      WHEN lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'k-%'
        OR lower(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'kindergarten%' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(
        substr(trim(s.GSserved), 1, instr(trim(s.GSserved) || '-', '-') - 1)
        AS INTEGER
      )
    END AS start_grade
  FROM schools AS s
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.DOC = '54'
    AND CAST(
      substr(trim(s.GSserved), instr(trim(s.GSserved), '-') + 1)
      AS INTEGER
    ) >= 12
    AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MIN(start_grade) OVER () AS earliest_start
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM ranked
WHERE start_grade = earliest_start
ORDER BY School;

  SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')

frpm_by_school AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    MAX("Enrollment (K-12)") AS enrollment,
    MAX("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
sat_by_school AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS combined_sat

  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
    AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
    AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL

  c.FundingType,
  COUNT(*) AS active_charter_school_count,
  SUM(f.enrollment) AS total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment,
  ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM charter_schools AS c
LEFT JOIN frpm_by_school AS f ON f.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school AS s ON s.cds = c.CDSCode
GROUP BY c.FundingType
ORDER BY c.FundingType;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(GSserved, '-') > 0
        THEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1)
      ELSE GSserved
    END AS first_grade
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
    AND DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
    AND GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE first_grade
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4
      WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7
      WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10
      WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13
      ELSE -1
    END AS grade_rank
  FROM candidates
),
score AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    SUM(enroll12) AS enroll12,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
  r.School AS school_name,
  r.first_grade AS earliest_grade_level,
  COALESCE(score.enroll12, 0) AS k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(score.takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN score ON score.cds = r.CDSCode
ORDER BY
  r.grade_rank DESC,
  COALESCE(score.enroll12, 0) DESC,
  r.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_year AS (

    FROM frpm
),
school_meals AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN latest_year AS y
        ON f."Academic Year" = y.year
    WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
      AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')

SELECT
    m.funding_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN s.CDSCode END) AS currently_operating_schools,

    SUM(m.frpm_k12) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM school_meals AS m

    ON s.CDSCode = m.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.Charter = 1
GROUP BY m.funding_type
ORDER BY CASE m.funding_type
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

        a.district_id AS branch_district_id
    FROM account AS a

    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id

  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id

  region,
  total_received,
  total_withdrawn,
  loan_count,

    GROUP BY d.account_id

    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                   THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
                   THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Debit' OR operation = 'Cash withdrawal'
                    THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT o.account_id,
           o.opened_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(
               (julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(o.birth_date)) / 365.2425
               AS INTEGER
           ) AS age_years,
           COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           CASE WHEN ls.loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
                ELSE ls.loan_standing
           END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(a.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(a.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(a.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(a.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM owners AS o
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = o.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_summary AS ls ON ls.account_id = o.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id

       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       transaction_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,

ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8

  FROM race_times, extremes
  WHERE start_seconds = earliest_seconds
), extremes
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'latest' AS timing,
  group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') AS circuit_refs,
  latest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
  latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM (

  FROM race_times, extremes

), extremes;

WITH fall_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS head_count
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
fall_average AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(head_count), 1) AS avg_head_count
  FROM fall_events
),
women_soccer AS (
  SELECT head_count
  FROM fall_events
  WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
)
SELECT
  w.head_count AS womens_soccer_students,
  f.avg_head_count AS fall_2019_average_students,
  CASE
    WHEN w.head_count > f.avg_head_count THEN 'more'
    WHEN w.head_count < f.avg_head_count THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM women_soccer AS w
CROSS JOIN fall_average AS f;

WITH food_purchase_records AS (
  SELECT e.expense_description
  FROM budget b
  JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE b.category = 'Food'
),
items AS (
  SELECT TRIM(j.value) AS item
  FROM food_purchase_records f,
       json_each('["' || REPLACE(REPLACE(f.expense_description, '"', '\"'), ', ', '","') || '"]') j
)
SELECT item, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM items
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

),

    SUM(e.cost) AS total_spending

  SELECT DISTINCT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Super Strength'
),
power_owners AS (
  SELECT hp.power_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id) AS total_owners,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sh.hero_id IS NOT NULL THEN hp.hero_id END) AS strength_owners

  GROUP BY hp.power_id
)

FROM power_owners
WHERE strength_owners > 0
  AND strength_owners = total_owners;

qualifying AS (
    SELECT g.gender, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count

        'W','RE','OS','IR','PT','AU','HG','TL','PB','BI','PO','FR','RA','AC','TH','PA','U',
        'NP','PU','AM','CM','BK','CF','ES','FM','MD','NO','LR'
      )
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

  )

baseline.sql:
WITH atom_bond_status AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN c.bond_id END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_bond_status
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND single_bond_count = bond_count
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

treatment.sql:
WITH atom_bond_profile AS (
    SELECT
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN b.bond_type IS NOT NULL AND b.bond_type <> 'single' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS non_single_bond_count
    FROM atom AS a
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c
        ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN bond AS b
        ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_bond_profile
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND non_single_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
